title: Round-2 seats saw the other seats' merged findings and dissent

found.context: Live runs of the untested 0.5.0 paths on the demo project, 2026-11-03: panel round 2

observed_failure: Each verification seat was told to read only the previous roadmap, but the file reader returned all of editorial_decision.json, including the synthesizer's merged findings and the seats' dissent. Four of five seats reported it.
expected_behavior: In subagent mode the orchestrator writes the roadmap list alone to the new round's panel/previous_roadmap.json and gives the seats that file. rce_roles.py already passes the roadmap only.

resolution.summary: adapters/claude_code.md and rce-panel.md: seats read panel/previous_roadmap.json; isolation in subagent mode stays enforced by instruction only

lessons: An instruction to read part of a file is not isolation: give the agent only the part.
